```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of transaction amounts by transaction type and fraud status
sns.boxplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', data=df, palette='muted')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount')
plt.title('Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status')

# Add legend
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
